title: Consume canonical GCP-3 key-rotation vectors in Python
description: P2 interop review after yzir canonicalization: gcp3_trust_models.json now fixes the domain || old key || old IID || new key || BE64 sequence transcript and regenerated signatures, but no Python test consumes those rotation entries. Add a Python production-oracle consumer that checks transcript bytes, Schnorr verdict, and TrustStore accept/reject behavior for every rotation vector so Rust/vector changes cannot silently diverge.
